text:
elaine.docs: FYI I opened a docs PR adding an 'Install runbooks' chapter for Private/VPC installs. Covers HSM partition notes, minimal egress for semi-airgapped sites, and an SDK conn-check snippet. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4821
sam.eng: Nice. Can we split it into two subsections (HSM runbook + Network runbook)? HSM needs clearer pkcs11 examples and failure-mode steps.
maria.security: From security: include a KMS key-wrap rotation caveat and explicit admonition to never check-in credentials. Also call out HSM ACLs and operator roles.
jin.sre: Quick SRE review: for semi-airgapped sites add an explicit minimal egress list for the conn-check tool. Example below (will add as snippet):
```
# minimal egress endpoints for conn-check (example)
34.120.0.0/14:443
52.23.0.0/16:443
# allow DNS to 1.1.1.1:53 or internal resolver as required
```
elaine.docs: Thanks — I'll split the chapters and add a security admonition. Removing any credential examples now. Also adding the SDK snippet for conn-check (Node and Go).
sam.eng: For the SDK example please use the official client name and a conservative example host (don't use prod hostnames). Something like:
```js
// Node example (conn-check via private endpoint)
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new RedwoodClient({ baseURL: 'https://private.local' });
await client.connCheck({ host: '10.0.0.5', port: 443 });
```
maria.security: LGTM. Also update HSM section language: replace "open pkcs11" with "configure pkcs11 plugin path via the KMS connector" and add note about least-privilege operator accounts.
jin.sre: I'll leave inline comments on the PR re: NAT hairpinning and MTU issues (we've hit them on baremetal installs). Added a short troubleshooting checklist suggestion.
elaine.docs: Updated PR: split HSM/network, removed creds, added key-rotation caveat and SRE checklist. Pushed commits and added changelog entry draft. Ping @docbot to run linkcheck and docs CI.
docbot: linkcheck: running...
docbot: linkcheck completed: 2 broken links found -> auto-fixed (redirects). Docs CI: build passed (warnings only).
sam.eng: :thumbsup: good to merge after you squash. Can you also add a short migration note for teams moving from managed KMS->HSM fallback?
elaine.docs: Good call — added a migration note and small command examples for config migration. Will squash & merge in ~30m after one last QA pass.
